title: Hong Kong sinks 4.5% and the Nikkei 4% as the AI scare hits Asia, while China's slide deepens
short: Hong Kong −4.5%, Nikkei −4%: AI scare hits Asia, China slides on
dek: Doubts about Big Tech's AI spending spread from Wall Street to Tokyo, Seoul and Hong Kong. Europe had its worst week since early September, and China's blue chips fell for an 11th straight week.
card: Hang Seng −4.52%, Nikkei about −4%, FTSE −1.8%, DAX −1.7% for the week. China's CSI 300 is in a bear market. What to watch for India.
